cancellation: If you need to change or cancel, please let us know as early as you can and we will do our best to move your appointment.

faqs.a: ETM stands for the Ethiopian Traditional Method. It is a holistic approach that supports the body's natural ability to restore balance, combining therapeutic touch with gentle movement, breathwork, relaxation, and practical lifestyle guidance. It was inspired by a childhood in Ethiopia rooted in faith, nature, and simple daily living, and shaped by more than fifteen years of hands-on work in wellness.

No. ETM is a complementary wellbeing practice focused on relaxation, easing tension, and supporting general wellbeing. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions, and it is not a substitute for medical care. Please continue with any treatment prescribed by your doctor, and speak to them about any health concerns.

If you are new to ETM, the Whole Body Reset is usually the best place to start, because it draws on every element of the approach. If your concern is mainly muscular, the Signature Massage is more focused. For jaw, scalp, and facial tension, choose the Facial Reset. If you would like support with stress or building habits, look at Breathwork or Lifestyle Coaching. If you are unsure, get in touch and we will help you choose.

faqs.q: What happens in a first session?
faqs.a: Every session begins with a conversation about your lifestyle, your goals, and how your body feels that day. Your treatment is then tailored to you using ETM principles. You will be talked through each stage before it happens, and you can pause or stop at any point. You leave with simple, practical guidance to take into everyday life.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: That depends on what you are bringing and what you would like to feel differently. Many people notice a difference after a single treatment. For longer-standing tension or for building new habits, a regular rhythm of sessions tends to work better than occasional ones. Meron will give you an honest view after your first session.

For massage treatments you will usually be asked to undress to your underwear, and you are covered with towels throughout with only the area being worked on exposed. You are welcome to keep on any clothing you prefer — the treatment will be adapted. Nothing happens without your agreement, and you set the depth and pace throughout.
Some are, with adaptation, and usually only after the first trimester. Please tell Meron you are pregnant when you enquire so the session can be adapted or an alternative suggested.

faqs.q: Is there anything I should mention before booking?
faqs.a: Yes — please let Meron know if you are pregnant, have a recent injury or surgery, are receiving medical treatment for any condition, or are taking medication that affects circulation or bruising. None of these necessarily rule out treatment, but they change what is appropriate.

faqs.q: Can I have a session online?
faqs.a: Breathwork Sessions and Lifestyle & Wellbeing Coaching both work well online. Massage and facial treatments require an in-person appointment.

faqs.q: What should I wear and bring?
faqs.a: Comfortable clothing you can move in. Arrive hydrated, avoid a heavy meal in the two hours beforehand, and give yourself a few extra minutes so your session does not begin in a rush.

Most people feel calmer, lighter, and noticeably more relaxed. Some feel unusually clear and energised instead. Both are normal. Drink plenty of water and keep the rest of your day gentle where you can.
Yes, for any treatment or for an open value. Request one through the booking form and we will arrange it.
Yes. A course of treatments booked together offers better value and a rhythm that helps change hold. Mention it in your enquiry and Meron will talk you through the options.

faqs.q: What if I need to cancel?
faqs.a: Please let us know as early as you can and we will do our best to move your appointment to another time. If you are unwell, do get in touch rather than attending.
